mapper.select: SELECT d.id,d.user_id author_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),'五行朋友') author_name,u.avatar_url, d.record_date,d.mood_code,d.mood_score,d.activity_content,d.feeling_content,d.user_id=#{viewerId} mine, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary_comment c WHERE c.diary_id=d.id AND c.status='0') comment_count,d.create_time FROM diary_record d JOIN app_user u ON u.id=d.user_id WHERE d.id=#{diaryId} AND d.status='1' AND d.privacy_type='1'
